name: MDZ
description: Error-bounded lossy compressor for molecular dynamics (MD) trajectory data, adaptively selecting between three snapshot-buffer prediction strategies based on spatial/temporal smoothness. Also known as MMD-SZ. Has been integrated into SZ3.

pipeline.name: Adaptive Predictor Selection
pipeline.description: Choose one of three prediction strategies per buffer of snapshots, trading off spatial vs. temporal smoothness
pipeline.note: Selected at runtime based on the data's spatial/temporal smoothness pattern
pipeline.moreInfo: VQ predicts purely from spatial information, so every snapshot decompresses independently with no cross-snapshot dependency -- best for datasets with very low smoothness in the time dimension. VQT bootstraps the buffer with a VQ prediction on the first snapshot, then predicts every remaining snapshot from the corresponding point in the previous snapshot (an ordinary time-based predictor) -- designed for datasets with smooth time dimension that also have strong multi-peak-distribution patterns in space. MT bootstraps with a specialized 'initial-time-based' prediction on the first snapshot, then applies the same ordinary time-based predictor as VQT to the rest -- particularly effective on datasets with very high smoothness in the time dimension.

alternatives.name: VQ
alternatives.description: Predicts every snapshot from spatial information alone via codebook lookup, so any snapshot decompresses independently -- best for data with very low smoothness across time

alternatives.name: VQT
alternatives.description: VQ prediction bootstraps the first snapshot in the buffer; every remaining snapshot is predicted from the same point in the previous snapshot -- best for data smooth in time with strong multi-peak spatial distributions

alternatives.name: MT
alternatives.description: A specialized initial-time-based prediction bootstraps the first snapshot; every remaining snapshot uses the same ordinary time-based predictor as VQT -- best for data with very high smoothness in the time dimension

pipeline.details: FZ Module Library's ALGO_BIOMD page describes this VQ/VQT/MT selection at the algorithm level; SZBioMDDecomposition has no separate catalog page of its own, so the link above points at ALGO_BIOMD.html rather than a dedicated module page.

name: FRSZ2
description: GPU compressor using a block-floating-point representation (shared max exponent per block, sign-prefixed normalized significands) with a fixed per-block truncation length.

pipeline.name: Exponent Extraction
pipeline.description: Extract each value's exponent and find the block's maximum exponent e_max

pipeline.name: Sign & Significand Extraction
pipeline.description: Extract the sign and significand of each value, restoring the usually-implicit leading 1 bit

pipeline.name: Significand Normalization
pipeline.description: Prefix each significand with k = e_max − e zero bits, aligning it to the block's shared maximum exponent

pipeline.name: Sign Integration
pipeline.description: Place the sign bit to the left of the normalized significand

pipeline.name: Truncation
pipeline.description: Cut the signed, normalized representation down to a fixed length l, producing the stored code c

pipeline.name: Storage
pipeline.description: Store e_max once and all per-value codes c for the block
